text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Ugh... their outer layer is tough, and damage isn't getting through easily!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くぅっ……
敵の外層が硬くて、
なかなかダメージが通らないッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Let me teach you something good, Matsuri-chan. Fighting straightforwardly from the front isn't the only way to battle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん、
いいことを教えてやろう。
馬鹿正直に正面から挑むばかりが戦いじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Dull their movements, weaken their defense... use any means at your disposal. No matter how much you talk about justice, if you don't have the power, you can't do anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
敵の足を鈍らせ、
防御を弱らせ……
使える手段は選ばずに使い倒せ。
正義をいくら語ろうが、
力及ばなければ何事も為せんぞ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Certainly, that's true. Let's work together and steadily chip away at the enemy's health!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かにその通りッスね。
ここは協力して
着実に敵の体力を削っていくッスよ！
